# Catch the icon the store is about to reject — before you upload

> Free tool: drop your App Store Connect or Google Play listing images in and check them before you upload — app icon transparency (the classic "can't contain an alpha channel" rejection), wrong pixel dimensions, a HEIC renamed to .png, and a screenshot set whose members disagree about their own size.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
